decisions.reason: As a design-led line extension that remained prominently presented in 2024, the black-finish range fits current bathroom aesthetics and is likely to stay unless demand proves too style-specific.

The seamless-covering shower channel is closely aligned with the firm's core drainage expertise and its focus on modern, barrier-free bathroom architecture, so it is very likely to remain in the portfolio.

The newly launched pump-drain shower channel addresses niche installation cases and supports innovation, but because pump-based variants can be more specialized and the firm has already refreshed similar concepts, its withdrawal risk is somewhat higher than the others.
